001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.format;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;
005
006/**
007 * Builder to create {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter }.
008 * Formats each event as a JSON object on one line, the same as the JSON5 formatter
009 * with format set to JSON, for example:
010 * <code>{"time":"2026-10-05T15:04:05.123Z","level":"INFO","logger":"com.example.App","threadId":"1","threadName":"main","message":"hello world","requestId":"42"}</code>.
011 * <p>
012 * The fields use logfmt's names: <code>time</code> (UTC instant with milliseconds),
013 * <code>level</code>, <code>logger</code>, the thread fields chosen with
014 * {@link ThreadFields} (by default <code>threadId</code> and
015 * <code>threadName</code>), <code>message</code>, and for a throwable
016 * <code>error</code> (its <code>toString()</code>) and <code>stacktrace</code>. Every
017 * value, key values and thread id included, is a string, or <code>null</code> for a
018 * key value without one. For a specific schema (ECS, GELF, Logstash) and more options
019 * use the <code>rainbowgum-json</code> module.
020 * <table class="table">
021 * <caption><strong>Properties retrieved from LogProperties</strong></caption>
022 * <tr>
023 * <th>Property Pattern</th>
024 * <th>Type</th>
025 * <th>Required</th>
026 * <th>Default</th>
027 * <th>Description</th>
028 * </tr>
029 * <tr>
030 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.json.keyValues" }</code></td>
031 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
032 * <td><code>true</code></td>
033 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesPlacement#MERGED merged}</td>
034 * <td>Where key values go, see {@link KeyValuesPlacement}.</td>
035 * </tr>
036 * <tr>
037 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.json.thread" }</code></td>
038 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
039 * <td><code>true</code></td>
040 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields#BOTH both}</td>
041 * <td>Which thread fields, see {@link ThreadFields}.</td>
042 * </tr>
043 * </table>
044 */
045public final class JsonFormatterBuilder implements io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogBuilder<JsonFormatterBuilder,io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter> {
046
047        /**
048         * The properties to be retrieved from config will have
049         * this prefix.
050         */
051        static final String PROPERTY_PREFIX = "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.json.";
052        
053        /**
054         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_keyValues } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesPlacement</code> Where key values go, see {@link KeyValuesPlacement}.
055         */
056        static final String PROPERTY_keyValues = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "keyValues";
057        /**
058         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_thread } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields</code> Which thread fields, see {@link ThreadFields}.
059         */
060        static final String PROPERTY_thread = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "thread";
061        
062        private final String propertyPrefix;
063        final String property_keyValues;
064        final String property_thread;
065        
066        private final java.lang.String name;
067        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesPlacement keyValues = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesPlacement.MERGED;
068        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields thread = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields.BOTH;
069        
070        /**
071         * Create a builder for {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter }.
072         * @param name will fill <code>{name}</code> in <code>logging.appender.{name}.encoder.json.</code>. Encoder name, used for property lookup.
073         */
074        public JsonFormatterBuilder(
075                        java.lang.String name
076                        ) {
077                try {
078                        java.util.Map<String,String> prefixParameters = java.util.Map.of(
079                                        "name", name
080                                );
081                        this.propertyPrefix = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_PREFIX, prefixParameters);
082                        this.name = name;
083                        property_keyValues = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_keyValues, prefixParameters);
084                        property_thread = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_thread, prefixParameters);
085                }
086                catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
087                        throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(this.getClass(), e);
088                }
089        }
090
091
092        
093        /**
094         * Sets <strong>required</strong> keyValues.
095         * Where key values go, see {@link KeyValuesPlacement}.
096         * Default is {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesPlacement#MERGED merged}.
097         * @param keyValues <code>{@value #PROPERTY_keyValues } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesPlacement</code> Where key values go, see {@link KeyValuesPlacement}.
098         * @return this builder.
099         */
100        public JsonFormatterBuilder keyValues(io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesPlacement keyValues) {
101                this.keyValues = keyValues;
102                return this;
103        }
104        
105        /**
106         * Sets <strong>required</strong> thread.
107         * Which thread fields, see {@link ThreadFields}.
108         * Default is {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields#BOTH both}.
109         * @param thread <code>{@value #PROPERTY_thread } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields</code> Which thread fields, see {@link ThreadFields}.
110         * @return this builder.
111         */
112        public JsonFormatterBuilder thread(io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields thread) {
113                this.thread = thread;
114                return this;
115        }
116        
117        /**
118         * Creates {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter } from this builder.
119         * @return {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter }.
120         */
121        public io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter build() {
122                try {
123                        return io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5Formatter.ofJson(
124                                        this.name
125                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_keyValues, this.keyValues)
126                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_thread, this.thread)
127                                        );
128                }
129                catch (IllegalArgumentException | LogProperty.PropertyMissingException e) {
130                        throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(this.getClass(), e);
131                }
132        }
133        
134        @Override
135        public JsonFormatterBuilder fromProperties(LogProperties properties) {
136                var __v = LogProperty.Validator.of(this.getClass());
137                var _keyValues = properties.forKey(property_keyValues).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5Formatter.convertKeyValues(_v)).or(this.keyValues).validate(__v);
138                var _thread = properties.forKey(property_thread).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5Formatter.convertThread(_v)).or(this.thread).validate(__v);
139                __v.validate();
140                this.keyValues = _keyValues.value();
141                this.thread = _thread.value();
142                return this;
143        }
144        
145        /**
146         * The interpolated property prefix: {@value #PROPERTY_PREFIX}.
147         * @return resolved prefix which should end with a "<code>.</code>".
148         */
149        @Override
150        public String propertyPrefix() {
151                return this.propertyPrefix;
152        }
153        
154}
